newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama, United States hold free trade talks.
newsitem.headline: Panama, United States hold free trade talks.

text.p: Panama and the United States started preliminary talks Tuesday as a first step toward a free trade agreement, Foreign Minister Ricardo Arias said.
"We'll meet over two days to plant the idea of reaching a free trade agreement with the United States," he told a news conference.
A delegation from the U.S. Commerce, State and Agriculture departments will hold informal talks with Panamanian officials.

Arias said Panama wanted "to continue our friendship with the United States beyond the year 2000," when the U.S. hands over control of the Panama Canal and withdraws all troops, according to bilateral treaties. Panama is expected to lose up to $370 million a year in revenue.
